title: Comparison of box-behnken design and gaussian process for optimising pectinase-assisted extraction of flavonoids from Malva sylvestris L.
summary: Pectinase-assisted extraction of collected Malva leaves/flowers; GP optimum yielded 2.08 ± 0.03 mg QE/g DW versus BBD 2.01 ± 0.07.
ai_technology: Authors identify Gaussian Process regression as machine-learning modelling; fitted on the same 15-run BBD dataset with leave-one-out cross-validation.

evidence.tested: Pectinase-assisted extraction of collected Malva leaves/flowers; GP optimum yielded 2.08 ± 0.03 mg QE/g DW versus BBD 2.01 ± 0.07. Lab extraction experiments and model comparison support a narrow process optimization result; paper states no scale-up or individual-flavonoid profiling.
evidence.unknown: The study does not establish performance or consequences beyond the reported cohort, datasets, task or experimental setup.
